clue.text: For the rest of the pupils, choice between two large numbers?

definitions.text: For the rest of the pupils

indicators.note: the word for a choice sits between the two numbers, so it is placed inside them

parts.note: in Roman numerals D is 500 and M is 1,000
or is the word that offers a choice

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about picking one of two big numbers.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a phrase: a school dormitory is where boarders go for their night's rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A school dormitory, shortened in speech, is the boarders' sleeping room.

clue.text: Cry of pain society girl is first to issue

indicators.note: the society girl comes before the cry of pain

parts.note: a deb is a debutante, a young woman entering society
ouch is an exclamation of pain

explanation.surface: A debutante cries out in pain as she is the first to come out.
explanation.definitionFit: To emerge from a narrow place into open ground, as troops or a river.

clue.text: A sandwich can make you plump

definitions.meaning: one ... of sandwiches, two slices with a filling

explanation.surface: Sandwiches will make you fat.
explanation.definitionFit: A round is one sandwich made from two slices; round also means chubby.

clue.text: Overcharge for material in basket

definitions.meaning: to charge a customer an excessive price, informal
the plant stems woven to make a basket

explanation.surface: A shopper is overcharged for wickerwork.
explanation.definitionFit: To rush a customer is slang for charging too much; rushes are plants woven into baskets.

clue.text: Put out of ground, having raised cheer

parts.note: up means raised or lifted
to root for a team is to cheer it on, informal

explanation.surface: A player sent off the pitch gives a raised cheer.
explanation.definitionFit: To pull a plant out of the earth, roots and all.

clue.text: Try to get matches for sporting chaps

parts.note: a judge hears or tries a case
ties are cup matches, as in a third-round tie

explanation.surface: Sportsmen attempt to get fixtures.
explanation.definitionFit: Hearty fellows are bluff, outdoor, sporty types.

clue.text: Thrust forward king in game of cards

parts.note: to poke is to jab or thrust forward
R is the abbreviation for king, from Latin rex

explanation.surface: A king card is pushed forward during a card game.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-known betting card game played with hands of five cards.

clue.text: R.N.L.I. might celebrate

definitions.meaning: the Royal National Lifeboat Institution launches lifeboats to sea

explanation.surface: The lifeboat charity may throw a party.
explanation.walkthrough: The RNLI is Britain's volunteer lifeboat charity.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for spending generously on a celebration; lifeboat crews literally launch.

clue.text: Venomous creature giving top man firm support

parts.note: a king is the man at the top
Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm
a bra is a supporting undergarment

explanation.surface: A creature gives its leader firm backing.
explanation.definitionFit: The world's longest venomous snake, native to South and Southeast Asia.

clue.text: Scale more correctly used in Scotland

definitions.meaning: Scots richt means right, so the comparative means more right

explanation.surface: A Scots usage that is more correct for a scale.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles Richter devised the scale measuring earthquake magnitude; in Scots, richt is right.

clue.text: Attack in China creating unnecessary fuss

parts.note: to storm is to attack violently
taken as written
a teacup is a piece of china

explanation.surface: An assault on China causing a needless fuss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' looks like the country, capitalised to mislead; it is crockery.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for great agitation over a trivial matter.

clue.text: Butlers unusually exhibiting braggadocio

indicators.note: the letters of the word butlers are set out in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Some servants are showing off in an odd way.
explanation.definitionFit: Braggadocio is boastful, swaggering talk, the same as loud empty boasting.

clue.text: As it is, a dangerous substance

definitions.meaning: As is the chemical symbol for this element, so As is what it is

explanation.surface: A remark that, things being as they are, something is dangerous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'As it is' looks like a stock phrase meaning 'in the present state'; read it as 'As' is its symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: The element with symbol As is a classic poison, a dangerous substance.

clue.text: Where an arch may be found to be in the way

definitions.text: Where an arch may be found
definitions.meaning: the arch of the foot lies below you as you stand

explanation.surface: A remark that an archway is an obstruction.
explanation.definitionFit: The arch of the foot is beneath you; something obstructive is literally where you tread.

clue.text: Bound by discretion, one is silent

indicators.note: one letter is enclosed, held in by the word for discretion

parts.note: tact is discretion in dealing with others
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone sworn to discretion stays quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: Tacit means unspoken, understood without words.

clue.text: He and I got special hamper

indicators.note: special suggests the letters are given a special new arrangement

explanation.surface: Two people collect a special gift basket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hamper' looks like a picnic basket, the noun; here it is the verb to hinder.
explanation.definitionFit: To tie someone's limbs together is to restrain or impede them.

clue.text: Amorous intrigue — everyone is in the frame

indicators.note: everyone is placed inside the frame

parts.note: a gantry is a frame, as for signals or a crane
all means everyone

explanation.surface: Everyone is implicated in a love affair.
explanation.definitionFit: Gallantry once meant flirtatious courtship or a love affair.

clue.text: Pay tribute to Sapper?

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army corps whose soldiers are sappers
a sapper is one member of that corps

explanation.surface: A tribute is paid to a military engineer.
explanation.walkthrough: A sapper is a soldier in the Royal Engineers (RE), so an RE member.
explanation.definitionFit: To commemorate the dead, as on a day of remembrance, is to honour them.

clue.text: Oarsman, dirty, finally found somewhere to wash up

parts.note: a sculler rows with sculls

indicators.note: only the last letter of the word dirty is taken

explanation.surface: A grubby rower finds a place to wash.
explanation.definitionFit: A back kitchen where dishes and pots are cleaned.

clue.text: Marriage of daughter extricated from casual affair

indicators.note: the letter for daughter is taken out of the word for a casual affair

parts.note: a dalliance is a casual romantic or sexual affair

explanation.surface: A daughter is pulled out of a fling into wedlock.
explanation.definitionFit: A union by marriage, as between royal houses, is a formal bond.

clue.text: A queen's stylish, without article that's old-fashioned

parts.note: R, for regina, is a queen

indicators.note: outside: the word for stylish goes round the article

parts.note: chic means stylish
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A queen is chic but lacks something old-fashioned.
explanation.definitionFit: Belonging to an earlier time, antiquated.

clue.text: Conflict-to tuck into fish or chicken?

indicators.note: the word for conflict is tucked inside the word for a fish

parts.note: the cod is a common food fish
war is armed conflict

explanation.surface: A diner faces a choice of fish or chicken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chicken' looks like the other dish on the menu; it is slang for a timid person.
explanation.definitionFit: Chicken is slang for someone lacking courage, a timid person.

clue.text: Follow revolutionary's easy pace

parts.note: to dog is to follow closely
a Trot is a Trotskyist revolutionary

explanation.surface: A revolutionary's relaxed walk.
explanation.definitionFit: A gentle, steady jogging gait like a dog's.

clue.text: Attack very likely to begin with

parts.note: assai is the musical term for very, as in allegro assai

indicators.note: only the first letter of the word likely is taken

explanation.surface: An attack is highly probable from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: ASSAI is an Italian tempo marking meaning very.
explanation.definitionFit: To assail is to assault or set upon violently.

clue.text: Derrick has to stretch out

definitions.meaning: a lifting machine with a jib
as to extend one's neck to see

explanation.surface: A man called Derrick must reach out.
explanation.definitionFit: A derrick is a hoisting machine; one cranes the neck by stretching it.

clue.text: Just before retiring, put cord round edges of tent

indicators.note: the cord is put round, enclosing the other letters

parts.note: lashing is cord used for tying down

indicators.note: the first and last letters of the word tent

explanation.surface: A camper ties the guy rope round the tent at bedtime.
explanation.definitionFit: The final act of the day, done immediately before going to bed.

clue.text: Kept in mind executives' power

indicators.note: the letters are kept inside the words mind executives

explanation.surface: Executives' power is something to bear in mind.
explanation.definitionFit: In mathematics an index is an exponent, the power a number is raised to.

clue.text: How to make us use embassy employee

parts.note: read as an instruction on letters: the two-letter word us becomes the three-letter word use by fixing a letter E onto its end

explanation.surface: A puzzling instruction about how to get us to use an embassy worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'How to make' asks for the instruction: US becomes USE when you fix an E on, in the answer's words ATTACH E.
explanation.definitionFit: An attaché is a diplomat posted to an embassy with a specialist role.

clue.text: Split, ut infra

parts.note: ut is Latin for as
infra is Latin for below, or under

explanation.surface: A Latin note, see below, referring to a split.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ut infra', as below, is a referencing tag in documents.
explanation.definitionFit: Apart, into pieces, as in torn apart.

clue.text: Praise lines entered in contest

indicators.note: the lines are put inside the word for a contest

parts.note: a cup is a trophy competition
RY is the abbreviation for railway, railway lines

explanation.surface: Words of praise are submitted to a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrasal verb meaning to extol or talk up loudly.

clue.text: Locksmith required by university

definitions.meaning: the Ivy League university in New Haven

explanation.surface: A university needs a locksmith.
explanation.definitionFit: Linus Yale invented the pin-tumbler lock; the US university shares the surname.

clue.text: Player's departure from English team ahead of time

indicators.note: the team comes before the letter for time

parts.note: XI, eleven, is a cricket or football team

explanation.surface: A player leaves the English side ahead of time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Player' is an actor: the stage direction for leaving.
explanation.definitionFit: A stage direction for an actor leaving the stage.
